manifest_row.title: Arctic Seismic Work Will Not Hurt Polar Bears, Government Says

screening.main_topic: A proposed seismic oil and gas survey in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge and its potential effects on polar bears.
screening.climate_relevance: The article explains that climate change is reducing sea ice, the polar bears’ main habitat, and links sea-ice loss to changes in where bears spend time on land. This provides meaningful context for the survey’s risks but is not the article’s main focus.
screening.reason: The main discussion concerns permitting, oil and gas exploration, and potential disturbance to polar bears and their dens. Climate change and sea-ice loss are relevant background rather than a central subject.
